Our Ingredient Philosophy

What You Leave Out Is Just as Important as What You Put In

At Daniel’s, we approach every recipe with one guiding principle: if an ingredient doesn’t actively benefit your pet, it has no place in our food. No fillers. No padding. No compromise.

We source everything with transparency and purpose — so you can feel confident knowing exactly what your pet is eating, and why every single ingredient earned its place in the bowl.

“We read every label as if we were feeding our own pets. Because we are.”

Why It Matters

Ingredients Shape Everything

The food your pet eats every single day is the single biggest influence on their health, energy, coat, digestion, and longevity. Ingredients matter more than anything else.

90%

of health issues in pets

are linked to poor nutrition — making daily diet the most powerful preventative tool available to any pet owner.

Zero

artificial additives in our food

Not a single artificial colour, flavour, or preservative appears in any Daniel’s recipe. This is a non-negotiable promise.

15+

years of careful sourcing

Over a decade of building relationships with trusted suppliers who share our values for quality and transparency.

The right ingredients support lifelong vitality

High-quality proteins maintain lean muscle mass. Omega fatty acids keep coats gleaming and joints supple. Natural antioxidants fight cellular damage and support immunity. Every ingredient in our recipes is there because science and experience confirm it makes a real difference to your pet’s daily life.

The wrong ingredients, by contrast — cheap fillers, artificial additives, unnamed by-products — can lead to weight issues, digestive problems, poor coat condition, and long-term health complications.

Transparency is not a bonus feature

We believe you have the right to know exactly what goes into your pet’s food. That’s why we name every protein source, list every ingredient in plain language, and never hide behind vague terms like “meat derivatives” or “animal by-products.”

When you read a Daniel’s label, you see chicken, salmon, or lamb — not a mystery. We think that level of honesty should be the standard, not the exception, in pet food.

What We Stand For

From Source to Bowl — Every Step Counts

Our process is as careful as our ingredients. We don’t just choose the right things — we handle them the right way, every single time.

01

Careful Selection

Every ingredient is vetted against our strict sourcing criteria before it ever reaches our kitchen. Quality is never assumed — it is verified.

02

Trusted Suppliers

We work with long-term partners who share our values. Relationships built on consistency, integrity, and a shared commitment to animal welfare.

03

Nutritional Balancing

Our recipes are formulated with veterinary nutritionists to achieve precise nutritional balance — not by guesswork, but by science.

04

Quality Assured

Every batch is tested before it leaves our facility. We hold ourselves to standards higher than regulations require, because that’s what your pet deserves.

What We Prioritise

The Ingredients That Define Our Food

Six core ingredient groups form the foundation of every Daniel’s recipe. Each chosen for a clear reason. Each serving a purpose you can feel in your pet’s health.

What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer, tablet, or mobile device when you visit a website.

Cookies allow a website to recognise your device and store certain information about your preferences or past actions. They help websites function efficiently and improve the user experience.

How We Use Cookies

Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods uses cookies for several purposes including:

Ensuring the website functions correctly

Remembering user preferences

Improving website performance

Understanding how visitors interact with the website

Supporting secure login and shopping cart functionality

Cookies help us improve our website and provide a better experience for visitors and customers.

Performance and Analytics Cookies

These cookies collect anonymous information about how visitors use the website. They help us understand which pages are most popular and how users move around the site.

You can choose to accept or reject cookies, or set your browser to notify you when a cookie is being placed.

Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the website.

More information about managing cookies can usually be found in your browser’s help section.

Contact Information

If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy or how your information is handled, you may contact us using the contact details provided on the Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods website.

Introduction 

At Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods we are committed to supplying high-quality nutrition  that pet owners can trust. Every product is carefully selected to ensure pets  receive safe, wholesome, and reliable food. If a genuine problem occurs with an  order, our team will always work with customers to resolve the matter fairly and  promptly. 

Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods operates as a trading name of Fresh Green Ltd.  

Your Right to Cancel  

Under the Consumer Contracts Regulations, customers have the right to cancel an online  order within 14 days of receiving the goods.  

If you wish to cancel your order within this period, you must notify us within 14 days of  receiving your delivery.  

Once cancellation has been confirmed, the goods should be returned within 14 days.  Returned products must be unused, unopened, and in their original packaging.  Refunds will be issued once the returned goods have been received and inspected.  

Please note that return postage costs may be the responsibility of the customer unless the  item is faulty or incorrect.  

Non Returnable Items  

For safety and hygiene reasons, certain items cannot be returned once opened. These may  include:  

Opened pet food  

Opened treats or supplements  

Perishable goods  

Products that have been used  

These items can only be refunded or replaced if they are faulty or damaged on arrival.  

Pet Food and Consumable Products  

For hygiene, safety, and quality assurance reasons, pet food and other consumable products  cannot be returned once the original packaging has been opened. 

Once a sealed food product has been opened, Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods can no longer  guarantee the integrity, freshness, or safe storage of the product. As a result, opened  products are considered unsuitable for resale and cannot safely be supplied to another pet  owner.  

Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods is committed to maintaining the highest standards of product quality  and trust. As a premium pet nutrition brand, we believe every pet owner should receive  products that are fresh, properly stored, and handled according to strict quality standards.  

For this reason, opened pet food, treats, supplements, or other consumable items are not  eligible for return or refund unless the product is confirmed to be faulty or damaged on  arrival.  

If a product arrives damaged or defective, customers must notify us within 48 hours of  delivery so that we can investigate and resolve the matter promptly.  

This approach protects the health of pets, maintains product integrity, and ensures that  every customer receives products of the quality they expect from Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods.  

Palatability and Individual Pet Preferences  

Every pet is unique, and individual animals may respond differently to new foods or  ingredients. While Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods carefully selects high quality products and trusted  suppliers, we cannot guarantee that every pet will prefer or tolerate a particular food. 

For this reason, refunds or returns cannot be offered for products that have been opened  where the reason for return is that a pet does not like the product, refuses the food, or  experiences a normal dietary adjustment when transitioning to a new food.  

Pet owners are encouraged to introduce new foods gradually and monitor their pet’s response  during the transition period.  

Where customers are unsure whether a product will suit their pet, we recommend purchasing  a smaller quantity initially before committing to larger bags.  

This policy ensures fairness to all customers while allowing Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods to  maintain the high standards of product quality, safety, and integrity expected from a premium  pet nutrition brand.  

Damaged or Faulty Goods  

If your order arrives damaged, faulty, or incorrect, please contact us as soon as possible after  receiving your delivery.  

To help us resolve the issue quickly, we may ask for photographs of the product and  packaging.  

Where a product is confirmed to be faulty or damaged, we will arrange one of the following:  • Replacement of the product 

• Refund of the purchase price  

• Alternative product of equal value where agreed  

In these circumstances Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods will cover any necessary return costs.  

Missing or Incorrect Items  

If an item is missing from your order or you have received the wrong product, please contact  us within 48 hours of delivery so that we can investigate and resolve the matter.  

Refund Process  

Refunds will be issued using the same payment method used for the original purchase  unless otherwise agreed.  

Once a refund has been approved, it will normally be processed within 5 to 10 working days  depending on the payment provider.  

Delivery Charges  

Original delivery charges are refundable when an order is cancelled within the legal  cancellation period.  

However, if an upgraded delivery service was chosen, the additional cost may not be  refunded.  

Products Delivered Directly From Suppliers  

Some products may be shipped directly from our trusted suppliers as part of our fulfilment  arrangements.  

Where this applies, returns may need to be sent directly to the supplier. We will provide  clear instructions if this is necessary.  

Contacting Us  

If you need to return an item or report a problem with your order, please contact us through  the contact details provided on the Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods website.  

We aim to respond to all enquiries promptly and resolve any issues as quickly as possible.  

Customer Care Commitment  

At Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods we care about the wellbeing of pets and the satisfaction of their  owners. If you ever experience a problem with your order, please contact us and we will do  our best to resolve the matter fairly and promptly.

Introduction  

Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods is committed to protecting the privacy and personal information of  our customers and visitors. This notice explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your  personal data when you visit our website, purchase products, or contact us.  

Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods operates as a trading name of Fresh Green Ltd.  

Data Controller  

The organisation responsible for processing your personal data is:  

Fresh Green Ltd

Trading as Daniel’s Tasty Petfoods  

United Kingdom  

If you have any questions about how your data is handled, you may contact us through the  contact form on our website or by email using the contact details provided on the website.  

Information We Collect  

We may collect the following types of personal information when you interact with our  website or services:  

• Name  

• Email address  

• Delivery address  

• Billing address  

• Telephone number  

• Payment information (processed securely through third party payment providers)  • Order history  

• Communication messages you send to us  

• Technical information such as IP address, browser type, and device information  

How We Use Your Information  

  • Your information is used for the following purposes:  
  • Processing and delivering your orders  
  • Providing customer service and responding to enquiries  
  • Managing your account if you create one on our website  
  • Sending order confirmations and service communications  
  • Improving our website and services
  • Sending marketing emails if you have consented to receive them  
  • Preventing fraud and maintaining website security  
  • We only collect the information that is necessary to provide our services effectively.  

Lawful Basis for Processing  

Under UK GDPR we rely on the following lawful bases when processing personal data:  

Contractual necessity – to process and deliver orders you place  

Legitimate interest – to operate and improve our business and services  Consent – for sending marketing emails or newsletters where you have chosen to receive  them  

Legal obligation – where we must retain certain records for tax or regulatory purposes  

Marketing Communications  

If you subscribe to our newsletter or marketing updates, we may send you information  about new products, pet care advice, and promotions.  

You can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link included in marketing  emails or by contacting us.  

Sharing Your Information  

We only share your information with trusted service providers where necessary to operate  our business. These may include:  

• Payment processors  

• Delivery and courier companies  

• Website hosting providers  

• Email communication services  

• Professional advisers such as accountants or legal advisers where required  

These organisations only receive the information necessary to perform their services and  must keep your information secure.  

We do not sell or rent personal data to third parties.  

Data Storage and Security  

We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal  information from unauthorised access, loss, or misuse.  

Your information is stored securely using reputable service providers that comply with  modern security standards.  

Data Retention  

We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes outlined  in this notice. 

Order records may be retained for up to six years to comply with tax and accounting  regulations.  

Your Rights Under Data Protection Law  

Under the UK GDPR you have several rights regarding your personal data. These include the  right to:  

• Access the personal information we hold about you  

• Request correction of inaccurate data  

• Request deletion of your personal data where appropriate  

• Restrict or object to certain processing activities  

• Request a copy of your data in a portable format  

• Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time  

If you wish to exercise any of these rights you may contact us through the contact details on  our website.  

Cookies  

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience,  analyse website traffic, and support website functionality.  

You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings.  

Pricing Transparency and Changes

We are committed to fair, transparent and honest pricing across all of our products and services. Any changes to our pricing will be communicated clearly in advance.

Where a price increase applies to an ongoing service or agreement, we will provide a minimum of 28 days’ written notice. This ensures that our customers have sufficient time to review the changes and make informed decisions.

We do not apply hidden charges or introduce mandatory fees at a later stage in the purchasing process. The price presented at the point of decision will reflect the full cost payable, except where optional additions are clearly selected by the customer.

 

Complaints  

If you believe your data has not been handled correctly, you have the right to make a  complaint to the Information Commissioner’s Office.  

Information Commissioner’s Office  

[www.ico.org.uk](http://www.ico.org.uk)  

Updates to This Notice  

We may update this privacy notice from time to time to reflect changes in legal  requirements or our services. The most recent version will always be available on our  website.  

Daniels Tasty Petfoods
